lines.en: I walk the arena's center line
My step crushes a floor tile
I circle the altar halfway
I walk from shadow into firelight
My plate scrapes the stone wall
I come nearer, step by step
I turn with a heavy swing
I shove a boulder aside
The tiles sink as I near
My shadow slides along the wall

lines.zh: 我是这座竞技场的二号
lines.en: I am number two of this arena
I slept for a very long time
My ki echoes inside me
Seated, I still block the light
I wait for you to cross the hall
Sparks ride my breath
I curl one finger
Every stone here knows me
I need no more sleep
I lift my face to the firelight
The altar smoke drifts my way
I count the echoes of the hall
I sit perfectly still
My tail rests on the steps
I rub my plate edge with a knuckle

lines.zh: 我把脚掌在台阶上放平
lines.en: I flatten my foot on the step
Your steps woke my sleep

lines.zh: 我抬眼看见一个小小的影子
lines.en: I raise my eyes to a small shadow

lines.zh: 你连我的膝盖都够不到
lines.en: You do not reach my knee
The gate has shut behind you
You should have heard my number
You should not have entered
You stand there, unmoving
I see your hand hunting a weapon
I rise to my feet slowly

lines.zh: 这座场地只有一个出口
lines.en: This hall has only one exit
I spread my hand before you

lines.zh: 竞技场的石砖被我一拳敲裂。
lines.en: One punch of mine cracks the arena flagstones.
A shallow dent marks my plate
That strike was decent
I settle my weight again
I press my palm to the hurt
My ki sways once
This is not yet much
I begin to take this seriously
The altar fire still burns high
A sleeping boss does not eat
Food does not sustain me
What you bring is not worth a sniff
What I await is a challenge
Move it, it blocks the firelight
Only one offering is honored here

lines.zh: 你的食物在这儿是垃圾
lines.en: Your food is refuse here

lines.zh: 我一口吞不下这么小的东西
lines.en: Such a small thing could not fill me
Save it for your companions
I have no interest at all
You hit my shin guard
I have not yielded an inch
You are bounced over
My plates are cold as stone
Push all you like, I stay
The knock carries across the hall
My knee meets your shoulder
That weight is nothing
You hit me a second time
The result is the same
My place is beside the altar
No one keeps me company here
I keep only my number
Challengers come one at a time
I have no need for that
I leave everything to battle
This topic means nothing
I keep my silence

lines.zh: 我睡了很久也没缺什么
lines.en: Long sleep left me wanting nothing
Ask me no more of it
I pick up a broken brick
It turns to powder in my hand
I set it on the steps
This thing is too small
I squeeze it and let it go
I hold it up to the light
I leave it before the altar
I cannot make sense of it
It was under my foot
I sweep it to one side
You are standing in my hall
I accept your challenge
This fight is beginning
I have raised my right arm
You left your retreat at the gate
I have watched you long enough
Only one of us stands here
I take my first step toward you
There are no onlookers
I add you to the list
You cut my long sleep short

lines.zh: 沉睡的骨节一节节撑开。
lines.en: My sleeping joints creak open one by one.
Your position is fixed now
You are at the altar edge
My afterimage stays with you
I expect you to dodge right
Your ki has lost its order
I lift my foot and set it down

lines.zh: 你在场地里跑不了多远
lines.en: You cannot run far in this hall
The fire stretches my shadow
Your hands are shaking
My ki presses the smoke down
You hear my joints creak
There is no luck in this hall
I fold the net in slowly
Your footing is loosening
I stay near you throughout
There is nowhere left to hide
I only strike once I am set
My palm slams your shoulder
My elbow swings across
I sweep you onto the steps
One punch splits the tiles
A blast fires from my palm
My knee drives into your chest
The afterimage reaches your back
I press you down with my weight

lines.zh: 你挡住第一下，第二下没挡住
lines.en: You stop the first, not the second
I stamp the floor beside your feet
The impact snuffs the torches
You are thrown into the stands
I pin you to the tiles
Your armor has a new dent
The dust on the altar stirs first
I sit up out of long sleep
The glow of my eyes comes first

lines.zh: 你靠近的那一刻我醒了
lines.en: I woke the moment you neared
A health bar rises over my head
The braziers ignite in turn
I shake the gravel off my shoulders

lines.zh: 我落地的声音传出很远
lines.en: My landing carries a long way

lines.zh: 整座场地的灰都扬起来
lines.en: Ash rises through the whole hall
I stand, taller than the gate

lines.zh: 祭坛的台阶在我脚下响
lines.en: The altar steps creak under me
My number echoes in the vault

lines.zh: 沉睡之后的第一次呼吸
lines.en: My first breath after sleeping

lines.zh: 我睁眼时火都低了一寸
lines.en: The flames dip as my eyes open
You have been left in this hall
This fight counts from now
I raise a hand and the smoke clears

lines.zh: 我听见门在你身后锁上
lines.en: I hear the gate lock behind you
The lamps find me one by one
It has been long since I fought

lines.zh: 火焰在我甲上爬了一圈
lines.en: Fire crawls once around my plate
I land and crush a step
Water fills my seams and chokes my ki
The blast tips me off balance
An arrow pings off my shell
Magic creeps in through my seams

lines.zh: 睡了这么久也没饿，只是耗空
lines.en: Long sleep left me unfed, only spent
Lightning winds around my shoulder

lines.zh: 整座祭坛跟着我往下坠
lines.en: The altar falls with me
